name: claude-skills
description: Engineering practice and methodology skills for Claude Code, distilled from canonical software-craftsmanship books (Clean Code, Refactoring, DDD, TDD, Lean, Kanban, and more).

plugins.name: engineering-practices
plugins.description: Thirty-nine engineering-practice skills covering design (Clean Code, SOLID, CUPID, DDD, Hexagonal Architecture), testing (TDD, BDD, Khorikov's unit-testing principles), refactoring (Fowler, Kerievsky, Tidy First, Feathers), delivery (CD, Kanban, Lean, Flow), product (Running Lean, Story Splitting, Example Mapping, Ticket Writing), and language-specific helpers (LanguageExt for C#).
